facts.fact: The Rua Augusta Arch stands at the end of the pedestrian street and offers views of Baixa and the river.
The arch symbolises the rebuilding of Lisbon after the 1755 earthquake, fire and tsunami.
The Clock Room contains an exhibition about the arch.

title: Visit Lisboa — Arco da Rua Augusta
